commands.command:
python3 -B -c 'import hashlib,json,pathlib,re,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path(".planning/phases/253-fix-flaky-ci-and-preserve-required-checks")
r=json.loads((p/"253-181-REPAIR-REVIEW.json").read_bytes())
v=r["amended_plan_validation"]
assert set(v)=={"253-179","253-180"}
node=pathlib.Path.home()/".asdf/installs/nodejs/20.18.1/bin/node"
sdk=pathlib.Path.home()/".codex/gsd-core/bin/gsd-tools.cjs"
assert node.is_file() and sdk.is_file()
for ident,wave,dep in (("253-179",2,"253-181"),("253-180",3,"253-179")):
 q=p/(ident+"-PLAN.md")
 raw=q.read_bytes()
 row=v[ident]
 assert row["plan_path"]==q.as_posix()
 assert row["plan_sha256"]==hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==r["source_files"][q.as_posix()]
 text=raw.decode("utf-8","strict")
 assert re.search(r"(?m)^wave: "+str(wave)+r"\s*$",text)
 assert re.search(r"(?m)^depends_on:\s*\[\x22"+dep+r"\x22\]\s*$",text)
 assert (p/(dep+"-PLAN.md")).is_file()
 for key,command,extra in (("frontmatter","frontmatter.validate",["--schema","plan-gap-closure"]),("structure","verify.plan-structure",[])):
  saved=row[key]
  argv=[str(node),str(sdk),"query",command,q.as_posix(),*extra]
  actual=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,check=False)
  assert actual.returncode==saved["exit_code"]==0,(ident,key,"nonzero validator")
  stdout=actual.stdout.decode("utf-8","strict")
  assert saved["argv"]==argv and saved["stdout"]==stdout,(ident,key,"retained command/output differs")
  assert hashlib.sha256(actual.stdout).hexdigest()==saved["stdout_sha256"]
  result=json.loads(stdout)
  assert isinstance(result,dict) and result.get("valid") is True,(ident,key,result)
  if key=="frontmatter":
   assert result.get("schema")=="plan-gap-closure" and result.get("missing")==[] and result.get("invalidValue")==[]
  else:
   assert result.get("errors")==[] and result.get("task_count")==2 and len(result.get("tasks",[]))==2
   assert all(all(t.get(k) is True for k in ("hasFiles","hasAction","hasVerify","hasDone")) for t in result["tasks"])
print("179/180 retained schema and structure results match fresh validators and exact amended bytes;waves/dependencies valid")'
